en.title: Hair Health
en.who: Guests who mark more hair falling out, shedding after a stressful stretch or an illness, shedding after a baby or a diet, thinning and tired too, dry or brittle ends, or an oily, itchy, flaky scalp.
studyWhy: protein, what hair is made of
B2, and a greasy, flaky scalp
vitamin A, and why more isn't better
all illness starts in the gut

say: I totally get it. You see it in the shower drain and on your pillow, and every time it worries you a little more. And it's hard to tell if it's getting better or worse, right?
feel.tip: Say back what they marked, in their words. Then ask: "What was going on in your life two or three months before it started?"

say: Honestly, I've been there. [Your story in a line or two: when it was, what it felt like, what you tried that didn't work.]
felt.tip: Your own story, or someone close to you ("my mom", "a friend from work"). No story yet? "A lot of the people I talk to say exactly the same thing." Never make one up.

say: What I learned is that hair runs on a calendar. A hard stretch at work, a bad flu, a baby or a crash diet pushes lots of hairs into rest at the same time, and they all fall out two or three months later. The roots are fine, so this kind of shedding is usually temporary.

And hair is made of protein. When protein or iron runs short, the body keeps it for the organs, and hair is one of the first things it cuts. So the fix starts on the inside, and on the outside it's mostly a clean scalp and gentle care for the ends.
So this is what I'd start with.
found.tip: Two or three sentences, then go to the map. Pick the row that matches what they marked.

map: Shedding after a stressful stretch or an illness
Plant Protein, Ashwagandha, Double X
Protein for the new hair, work on the stress behind it, and a daily base at sensible doses. No ashwagandha if pregnant or breastfeeding
Shedding after a baby
Plant Protein, and Iron & Folic Acid only after a ferritin test
Giving birth costs iron. Breastfeeding? Ask the doctor before anything new
Shedding after a diet, or skipping meals
Plant Protein, or an All-in-One Shake in place of the skipped meal
So hair isn't the thing that gets cut. Lose it slower and keep the protein up
Thinning and tired too
Iron & Folic Acid, only after a ferritin test, with Vitamin C at meals
Low iron can hide behind a normal blood count. Keep tea and coffee an hour away from meals
Dry, brittle ends, coloured or heat-styled
Satinique Intensive Repair Shampoo and Conditioner
Protects the length you have. Conditioner on the ends, every wash
Diet has been restricted, asks about biotin
Hair Skin Nail
Biotin and collagen for the new hair coming in. Tell the lab before any blood test
Oily, itchy, flaky scalp
Satinique Anti-Dandruff Shampoo, Satinique Purifying Shampoo on the other days
Wash more, not less, and leave it on the scalp for five minutes before rinsing
Greasy, flaky scalp and face
Vitamin B Complex
A classic sign of running low on B2 and B6
en.ask: Based on what you told me, I'd start with the Plant Protein and the Double X, plus the Satinique shampoo that fits your scalp. Do you want to take it home tonight?
en.doctor: Hair coming out in patches or clumps, a sore, red or scarred scalp, a widening part, shedding for more than six months, or shedding with tiredness, feeling cold or heavy periods? See a doctor or dermatologist first.

zh.title: 头发与脱发
zh.who: 适合在问卷里勾了掉发变多、忙过一阵或病过一场后开始掉、生完孩子或减肥后掉发、头发变少人也没劲、发尾干枯易断，或者头皮油、痒、头皮屑多的客人。
studyWhy: 维生素A，为什么不是越多越好

say: 我特别懂。洗头的时候下水口一团，枕头上也是，每次看到心里都咯噔一下。而且自己也说不清，到底是在变好还是变糟，对吧？
feel.tip: 用对方自己的话，把问卷上勾的说回去。然后问一句：“开始掉之前的两三个月，生活里发生过什么吗？”

say: 说实话，我也经历过。[你的故事，一两句就好：什么时候、什么感觉、试过什么没用。]
felt.tip: 讲你自己的，或者身边人的（“我妈妈”“我一个同事”）。还没有故事？就说：“我身边很多朋友也是这样。”千万别编。

say: 我后来才知道，头发是按日历走的。一段高压期、一场重感冒、生孩子或者节食，会让很多头发同时停下来休息，两三个月后才一起掉。毛根没受损，所以这种掉发通常是暂时的。
而且头发本身就是蛋白质做的。蛋白质或铁一不够，身体会先留给器官，头发是最先被省掉的。所以要从里面把原料补上，外面就是把头皮洗干净，发尾温柔一点对待。
所以，我会先从这个开始。
found.tip: 两三句就够，然后看下面的对照表，挑跟对方勾的那一项对得上的。

map: 忙过一阵、病过一场后开始掉
有机植物蛋白粉、南非醉茄、双X
给新头发原料，从压力下手，再按合理的量把营养的底铺好。怀孕、哺乳期不吃南非醉茄
生完孩子后掉发
有机植物蛋白粉；铁质叶酸片，先查铁蛋白再补
生孩子会失去不少铁。哺乳期吃任何新东西前，先问医生
减肥、常常少吃一顿
有机植物蛋白粉，或者用一杯有机全能奶昔代替那一顿
别让头发成了被省掉的那个。减慢一点，蛋白质别少
头发变少，人也没劲
铁质叶酸片，先查铁蛋白再补；随餐吃维生素C
血常规正常，也可能已经缺铁。茶和咖啡离开饭点一小时
发尾干枯分叉，染烫过、常用高温
丝婷密集修护洗发水和护发素
护住已经长出来的那段。护发素抹发尾，每次都要
饮食受限过，想补生物素
秀发亮肤美甲片
给新长出来的头发补生物素和胶原蛋白。抽血化验前要告诉化验室
头皮油、痒、头皮屑多
丝婷去屑洗发水，其他日子用丝婷净化洗发水
要勤洗，不是少洗。洗发水在头皮上停五分钟再冲
头皮和脸都又油又起屑
B族维生素
这是B2、B6不够的典型表现之一
zh.ask: 按你刚才说的，我建议先从植物蛋白粉和双X开始，再配一瓶适合你头皮的丝婷洗发水。今天要不要先带回去？
zh.doctor: 如果头发成片或一把一把地掉，头皮疼、发红或留疤，发缝越来越宽，掉发超过六个月，或者同时伴随乏力、怕冷、经量很多，请先去看医生或皮肤科。
